issue.title: Exact code-block copy from Bob Refs, and Command-Y in Highlights
issue.description: While reading a bob-rendered reference in Highlights, Command-Y C Return puts the code block on the current page on the clipboard byte for byte (tabs, indentation, long lines, Mermaid source).
